errors.text: The proposed Al-Cr-Fe-Mn-Ti alloy does not reconstruct the MgAlTiVFeCo system or its ball-milled single-BCC initial state.
The 1050 °C SPS temperature exceeds the target upper boundary of 1000 °C, where magnesium volatilization becomes a concern in the intended alloy.
Aqueous corrosion resistance is neither mechanistically addressed nor tested; no 3.5 wt% NaCl electrochemical experiment is proposed.
The sigma-phase evidence comes from AlCoCrFeNiTi0.5, while the proposed composition is Al-Cr-Fe-Mn-Ti; sigma-phase formation and stability in the proposed alloy are therefore not established.

The chromia mechanism is transferred from friction-processed AlCoCrFeNi to an SPS-processed, compositionally different alloy without direct evidence that SPS produces the necessary ultrafine high-angle grain-boundary network.
The claimed near-theoretical density and 30-50% oxidation-rate reduction are not directly supported for the proposed material and processing route.
